effect: Moth's role is now clear: help is optional, and the sender can review and keep their original wording. The request-desk goal is complete.
reaction: Sal keeping her original wording is a satisfying demonstration of real choice.

mostWorthwhile.text: Setting up the private request desk was most worthwhile: the receipt keeps return details off the shared queue, and the pencil offers a way to ask without using the tablet.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the printer took two separate actions, making the assembly feel slightly drawn out, though the remaining setup was clear.

surprise.text: Inspecting the tablet automatically removed the listening app and disconnected its microphone; I hadn't expected the privacy fix to include a physical disconnection.

arbitrary.text: Moth's exact role at the desk was unclear when I combined it with the finished desk; I was following the remaining available item rather than a specific clue.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical privacy choices and Moth's optional, reviewable help made me curious how the neighborhood will use its local infrastructure.
